 ╭─ Run command ──────────────────────────────────╮
 │ gh issue list --label bug                      │
 │                                                │
 │ Do you want to run this command?               │
 │ ❯ 1. Yes                                       │
 │   2. Yes, and approve gh for the rest of the   │
 │      running session                           │
 │   3. No, and tell Copilot what to do           │
 │      differently (Esc)                         │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
   ↑↓ to navigate · enter to select · esc to cancel
